title: Customer care analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Customer care analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?   At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.   DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.   About The Job   The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.   This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.   Working Tasks and Responsibilities   Supporting all post-sales activities. Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment. Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc. Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed. What You'll Bring   Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace. Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.   At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.   We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.   Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at Deif. Com.

Para saber mais sobre a Liu Gong, visite: nosso site global ( ou o site da América Latina (      O que buscamos? Estudantes das áreas de engenharia de automação, ciências contábeis, economia ou áreas correlatas, com graduação a partir de dezembro de 2027; Disponibilidade para atuar de forma presencial em Campinas; Disponibilidade para atuar das 8h às 15h de segunda à sexta; Interesse na área de crédito e contas a receber; Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita; Espírito de equipe, organização, proatividade e perfil analítico, além de grande vontade de aprender na prática. Importante mencionar que os horários apresentados não são flexíveis . Sugerimos que verifique sua grade horária de aulas antes da candidatura.      O que oferecemos? Assistência Médica; Assistência Odontológica; Vale Alimentação ou Refeição; Convênio Farmácia; Previdência Privada; Seguro de Vida. Auxílio Transporte (para moradores de Mogi Guaçu é oferecido o fretado); Benefícios de fim de ano com Cesta de Natal Trilha de desenvolvimento do estagiário ao longo do Programa; Vivência em ambiente intercultural; Possibilidade de crescimento interno. title: Customer care analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Customer care analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability? At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil. DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions. About The Job The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients. This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges. Working Tasks and Responsibilities Supporting all post-sales activities. Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment. Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc. Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed. What You'll Bring Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace. Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application. At DEIF, we are Winning Together! We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at.

title: Assistente comercial
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Assistente comercial em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

QUEM SOMOS      Nascemos fruto da união de propósitos entre a Bunge e UPL, uma joint venture de proposta inovadora e exclusiva: levar a solução completa ao produtor.    Somos a ORÍ GEO e viemos construir uma relação próxima que simplifique o dia a dia da lavoura, lado a lado do produtor sendo seu parceiro da semente à comercialização, visando uma agricultura produtiva, sustentável e em constante evolução.      PROPÓ SITO DO CARGO      O(A) Assistente Comercial tem como objetivo principal fornecer suporte administrativo e operacional a equipe comercial através da interação com as áreas do escritório e realizando acompanhamento de pedidos no sistema, extraindo e disponibilizando relatórios de vendas e carteira de pedidos, bem como acompanhando a liberação de crédito, faturamento e logística, visando garantir eficiência e agilidade em todos os processos, reduzir erros e retrabalhos, e assegurar conformidade (compliance) com políticas internas.      RESPONSABILIDADES     Conferir e monitorar os pedidos no sistema, validando as informações com o time de vendas e interagindo com as áreas de crédito e supply chain, com intuito de assegurar agilidade no ciclo de vendas e evitar impactos no faturamento. Controlar e atualizar relatórios de carteira, estoque e faturamento, coletando dados no sistema, organizando planilhas e compartilhando informações com o time comercial, visando fornecer mais visibilidade e transparência sobre os resultados. Acompanhar e simplificar o fluxo de transações entre a administração de vendas e o time comercial, monitorando processos de faturamento, solicitações e negociações, a fim de tornar o processo mais ágil e integrado entre as áreas. Acompanhar e monitorar o processo de assinatura de contratos por meio do sistema de BI, validando e informando os Gestores de Soluções (GS) sobre os documentos ainda pendentes de assinatura, com o objetivo de evitar riscos jurídicos e continuidade do processo de pagamento pelos clientes. Monitorar as cotas da BU junto ao HUB e à área de Administração de Vendas, validando e informando os GS sobre as cotas disponíveis para faturamento, com intuito de assegurar que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos corretamente e dentro dos prazos combinados. Apoiar o time de campo em demandas gerais da área, mantendo comunicação proativa, buscando soluções rápidas e acompanhando cada caso até sua resolução, contribuindo para a fluidez e eficiência no atendimento dos clientes.    QUALIFICAÇÕ ES     Ensino médio Completo sendo desejável Formação Superior cursando Excel intermediário Experiência na parte backoffice comercial Experiência com controles de relatórios Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente de segunda à quinta    Nós, da ORÍ GEO, acreditamos que um time com diversidade constrói grandes histórias. Por isso, se você é uma Pessoa com Deficiência e se identificou com essa vaga, participe do nosso processo seletivo!

title: Customer care analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer care analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability? At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil. DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions. About The Job The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients. This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges. Working Tasks and Responsibilities Supporting all post-sales activities. Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment. Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc. Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed. What You'll Bring Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace. Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application. At DEIF, we are Winning Together! We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. title: Customer care (campinas/sp, brasil) - sqm iodo nutrição vegetal
description:

Atuação direta na otimização do nível de serviço, balanceamento de estoques e aumento da eficiência operacional. Fortalecimento da governança comercial e da previsibilidade da execução, contribuindo para maior assertividade no planejamento e acompanhamento dos resultados. You will have a chance to work across diverse industries and product lifecycles, partnering with some of the world's most recognisable brands. An experimental mindset combined with rigour: you are comfortable trying new tools and approaches, while knowing the true value of user research and guardrails. Proven experience assessing and validating early product concepts with various methods, not only interviews. Skilled in defining customer segmentation across various markets. Experience with recruiting participants for research. A star facilitator, known for leading workshops, design sprints, and co-creation sessions that spark creativity and build alignment. Strong sense of ownership and the drive to move work forward without waiting to be asked. You thrive on minimal direction: we'll support you, but we want you to be the one moving things forward. Stellar communication: advising, negotiating, and effectively collaborating with stakeholders at all levels. title: Senior revops analyst - churn
description:

Contract Type:Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.About the Role We are seekinga Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churnto join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

description:

Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Pessoa encarregada de limpeza
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Pessoa encarregada de limpeza em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.      A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.      Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.      E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.      Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.      Responsabilidades e atribuições: Acompanhar e orientar as equipes de limpeza nas rotinas diárias e turnos de trabalho; Distribuir atividades conforme escala, prioridades e necessidades operacionais; Realizar vistorias periódicas em áreas comuns, banheiros e áreas de apoio, corrigindo desvios; Garantir o correto uso de produtos, equipamentos e EPIs; Monitorar frequência, pontualidade e comportamento da equipe, reportando ocorrências; Apoiar a passagem de turno, assegurando alinhamento entre as equipes; Acompanhar a coleta, separação e descarte adequado de resíduos; Controlar o uso de materiais e sinalizar necessidades de reposição; Apoiar atividades de dedetização e demais serviços correlatos.    Requisitos e qualificações: Experiência anterior na área; Conhecimento básico em produtos de limpeza, descarte de resíduos e normas de segurança; Disponibilidade para atuação em escala e turnos. Vivência em shopping center, hospitais, condomínios ou grandes operações; Experiência com equipes terceirizadas; Noções de sustentabilidade e boas práticas ambientais.    Informações adicionais:    O Que Temos Para Você     Vale Refeição/Alimentação; Vale Transporte/Estacionamento; Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de vida; Auxílio Academia; Day Off Aniversário; Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem); PLR.    Local de trabalho: Parque Dom Pedro - Campinas SP;    Modelo de trabalho: 100% Presencial;    Escala de trabalho: 6x1 - 14hs às 22hs;

Prevenir contaminações por meio do fortalecimento de práticas de: Sanitização e Design sanitário Liderar a gestão de crises e situações críticas , incluindo recalls e incidentes com clientes. Atuar em interface constante com: Serviço ao cliente, Áreas internas e stakeholders globais Conduzir e suportar auditorias de clientes e órgãos reguladores (ANVISA, MAPA). Garantir que a operação esteja preparada para inspeções e auditorias externas. Participar de reuniões globais de qualidade , visitas e interações com stakeholders internacionais (comunicação em inglês). Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de qualidade e segurança de alimentos. Atuar como agente de mudança na área, fortalecendo estrutura, cultura e estabilidade da equipe.    Qualifications and skills Formação superior em: Química, Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas Experiência mínima de 5 anos como gerente em qualidade, food safety ou areas correlatas na indústria de alimentos. Forte conhecimento técnico em: Food Safety e sistemas de Qualidade Experiência prática na gestão de Problemas operacionais, situações críticas e crises Vivência comprovada com: Auditorias externas e órgãos reguladores (ANVISA, MAPA) Experiência em empresas de grande porte Forte capacidade de: Trabalho em equipe, Formação e desenvolvimento de times Alta capacidade de execução, resiliente e orientado a resultados. Processos & Indicadores     Atualizar informações em CRM e sistemas internos; Acompanhar métricas relacionadas à satisfação, engajamento e retenção; Elaborar relatórios e análises simples sobre a carteira de clientes; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos da área de Customer Success.    Requisitos     Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Logística, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas; Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Atendimento ao Cliente, Suporte ou áreas de relacionamento; Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; Conhecimento básico/intermediário em Excel ou Google Sheets; Facilidade para organização e acompanhamento de múltiplas demandas; Perfil proativo, colaborativo e orientado à solução de problemas.    Diferenciais     Experiência com plataformas Saa S; Conhecimento em CRM (Hub Spot, Pipedrive, Salesforce ou similares); Vivência com atendimento B2 B; Conhecimento em logística, transporte ou supply chain; Familiaridade com indicadores de Customer Success (NPS, Churn, Health Score, CSAT); Interesse por tecnologia, inovação e inteligência artificial. Buscamos pessoas que gostem de criar conexões, resolver problemas, aprender continuamente e gerar valor por meio de relacionamentos duradouros. title: Consolidation specialist/especialista de consolidação - oportunidade também para pcd♿
description:
Empresa está contratando Consolidation specialist/especialista de consolidação - oportunidade também para pcd♿ em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:      The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.    The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.      KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:      Quarterly package review - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.   - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.   - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.   - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.   - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.      Group analyses - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.      One-off items - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.   - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M& A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.   - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.      OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.      REQUIREMENTS:    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).    Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.    Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).      Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:      Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4 HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).    Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.    Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.      In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

Valorizamos a criatividade, a inovação e a excelência técnica em todos os nossos projetos. O profissional será responsável por transformar materiais brutos em vídeos envolventes e de alta qualidade, garantindo que cada projeto tenha uma narrativa coesa e um acabamento profissional, alinhado às diretrizes e identidade visual de cada criador que agenciamos. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES   · Residir em Campinas ou região metropolitana.     · Experiência comprovada na edição de múltiplos projetos de vídeo, com portfólio que demonstre suas habilidades.     · Domínio técnico do Pacote Adobe, com proficiência em Adobe Premiere Pro. Conhecimento em After Effects e Audition será considerado um diferencial.     · Perfil proativo, com habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma, gerenciar prazos e solucionar problemas.     · Forte senso de narrativa e storytelling visual.     · Atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a qualidade da entrega final. At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.      DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions. This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.      Working Tasks and Responsibilities Supporting all post-sales activities. Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment. Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc. Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.    What You’ll Bring Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.    Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.      At DEIF, we are Winning Together!    We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.      We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. title: Project manager #1008790

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.Nosso Cliente Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a pontade quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte deum projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést i cos.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight) Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa.
